perf.notes: v0.22 shipping/perf UPGRADE: examples/interactive-prop sessionstart (after 90/72 + FFR 0.75 + v0.15 pixel-ratio clamp to 1 + v0.16 antialias/MSAA-off verify + v0.17 NoToneMapping + v0.18 IBL/environment off + v0.19 directional off + v0.20 ambient-only fill + v0.21 texture anisotropy clamp to 1) saves the last-set / documented lookdev XR framebuffer scale and writes QUEST3_XR_FRAMEBUFFER_SCALE (1). setPixelRatio (v0.15) and setFramebufferScaleFactor are different knobs — the latter scales the XR eye buffer vs the runtime recommended size. Three r170 WebXRManager has setFramebufferScaleFactor only (no getFramebufferScaleFactor; private default 1.0). r170 snapshots the factor in setSession (sessionstart fires after isPresenting=true); a set while presenting updates the private factor for the next layer and does not rebuild the current XRWebGLLayer. The example therefore also sets 1 at renderer setup (before VRButton / setSession) so the current session inherits the clamp. sessionend restores the saved lookdev/desktop scale first (reverse-safe; isPresenting is already false). Raising above 1 is stretch-only and must be measured on-device. Session events only — not per-frame (v0.8 allocation scrub kept). Draws/tris/texture caps unchanged vs v0.21/v0.20/v0.19/v0.18/v0.17/v0.16/v0.15/v0.14 (LOD1 half normalScale; LOD2 no normalMap). v0.21 anisotropy clamp, v0.20 ambient-only fill, v0.19 directional off, v0.18 IBL off, v0.17 NoToneMapping, v0.16 MSAA off, v0.15 pixel-ratio clamp, v0.14 LOD1 normalScale, v0.13 LOD2 no-normals, v0.12 normals, v0.11 visibility-loss release, v0.10 tracking-loss / null-pose release, v0.9 hand hover-before-pinch, and v0.8 allocation scrub kept (no per-frame new THREE.* when P overlay is off). L3 packaging recipe still docs/performance/ktx2-quest3-packaging.md; runtime probes /packaged/crate-toolbox.glb and falls back to procedural 512² canvases. No GLB in this revision. LOD draws unchanged (14/8/2 + fastener 1). Quest 3 frame time / FFR still unmeasured.
